_readme: Register of customer feedback boards. A HINT, never an authority: it saves board/list discovery calls, but live card data settles every question. Verify listIds against live data before any write; on drift, update the entry, bump listsVerifiedAt, and report the delta. Fields: connector = which MCP server can read this board (claude-ai | local). commentLanguage = language for customer-facing card comments. backlinkStyle = comment (notifies the customer) | silent-attachment (does not). resolutionMechanism = how finished work leaves the board (column | archival) — note neither is terminal, customers un-archive and pull cards back. packageVersion = the customer's qms-package slot, which sets their deploy cut-off. joinKey is PER BOARD, not global. roles vocabulary: intake, blocking, backlog, bugs, phase2, in-progress, waiting, awaiting-deploy, resolved, improvement, wont-do.

linearProjects: Certain QMS - Small tasks and bugs.
apotek1.joinKey: card title number (this board numbers every card); shortLink as tiebreak
notes: Card title number diverges from Trello idShort from title 60 upward (title 60 = idShort 61), because idShort 60's card was deleted. Linear's existing 'Trello card #NN' rows use title numbers.
The awaiting-deploy column was added 2026-09-04 and holds both genuinely queued work and work blocked behind a FAILED deploy. Distinguish the two in comments.
Column order puts awaiting-deploy BEFORE resolved, so moving a card there from Done is backward in list order. See SKILL.md on when that is legitimate.

risa.joinKey: shortLink / url attachment ONLY. Most card titles carry no number, and idShort is NOT unique on this board (duplicate #1/#2 from board templates and imports from the closed test-phase board). Semantic NO-to-EN title matching is the last resort.
notes: NO awaiting-deploy column exists. Do not create one. Output is a comment plus the report.
Bugs / feilretting and Prioritering Fase 2 were created 2026-09-01 and Kritisk + Backlog were fully drained into them, so both older lists are now empty but still live roles.
Roughly 40 percent of the board is NP365 work owned by the P365 Linear team. P365 issues link AZURE DEVOPS, not GitLab, so the GitLab merge-state recipe cannot reach them.
Cards #158 / #61 are SPFx webpart work that ships via the SharePoint app catalog, not the qms package. No cut-off recipe covers it; classify as Unverifiable.
Attachments do not notify the customer; comments do. Hence backlinkStyle silent-attachment.
Archival is not terminal: the customer un-archived #142 on 2026-09-07 to reopen it. Customers also pull cards back out of ✅ Løst when they disagree.
✅ Løst is not a delivery count. It contains won't-fix closures (#4) and work the customer built himself (#79).
Older board 'Risa Test Phase' 69f8e21ae1697fedb164c10b is closed/archived. Ignore it, but some Linear descriptions still link to its cards.
